confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of mainland Chinese resort pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and drink anchors are medium confidence. Accommodation is lower confidence because July is peak domestic holiday season in Sanya and rates vary widely by district and season. FX caveat: the 2026-10-16 value of 0.6947 came from a third-party aggregator (ozfinancehub.com.au) that attributes it to RBA data. I did not open any rba.gov.au page, so the RBA figure and source_url are unverified. Trading Economics shows 0.6923 for the same day. Verify against the RBA F11 daily table before using the FX value for conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Hainan's coastal resort tier, compared with other Chinese coastal tourist cities (e.g., Xiamen, Haikou) and mainland Chinese domestic restaurant and hotel pricing, adjusted for July peak-season resort demand.
